title: Emit a positive commutator Gram instrument without controlling the unknown source

scientific_scope_status: The completed review accepts a one-complete-source-call CP instrument under trusted isolated coherent controls and the SAME source map across branches. Pure coherent nine-label control emits the positive Gram transpose H^T/18 in the stated minus branch; arbitrary control rho gives rho Hadamard H^T/2. Retiring the full plus/minus control leaves one ordinary maximally-mixed-input source-memory update.

unavailable_or_unclassified: A pure coherent label superposition is required; a classical uniform mixture is different. Output is neither H rho H, an inverse, a prepared kernel state nor a recovery algorithm. Direct scalar objective use gives a smaller Bernoulli signal than the ordinary positive Bell-sign probe and needs more coherent controls. The222-CNOT/398-single-gate budget is a compositional upper bound, not a full executed elementary netlist or hardware result. N1041 supplies only its actual isolated-control scope.
